description: Skill-selection routing corpus (#110). Each ask must route to exactly one skill via the quoted trigger phrases its frontmatter description advertises. Grading is deterministic — substring match on those phrases, no live tenant and no model — so a description collision (see #103 Finding A) fails CI instead of surfacing as an analyst getting the wrong skill's governance. New skill => new cases; the tie-breaks for deliberately-ambiguous asks are recorded here as tested decisions, not left to model mood.

cases.ask: why is this rule so loud
